feeds.title: PhoenixLifeCoach Blog
feeds.description: You know you are capable of more but feel stuck and don't know how to get out of it. You know you want to thrive in life but you need support to help you remove the blockers and achieve fulfillment. Phoenix Coaching helps you rise to be the best version of you.

feeds.title: Dr De-Stress
feeds.description: Mariette is a no nonsense mindfulness life coach and meditation teacher in Surrey and offers distinctively different coaching, a combination of psychology models, coaching methods and mindfulness for quick results.

feeds.title: Kate Grosvenor Blog
feeds.description: Kate Grosvenor lives in Yorkshire with her partner, 3 teenage daughters and 4 cats. She is a Transformational Life Coach, former Headteacher with a background in Psychology, and is a published author of psychology and lifestyle books. Kate is a regular contributor on BBC Radio Sheffield and has been on both multiple local and national BBC Radio, as well being regularly featured as a writer in Clarityy News.

feeds.title: Nick Hatter Blog
feeds.description: A leading life coach in London. Coach of actors, musicians, CEOs, psychiatrists. Career coaching and life coaching. Featured on BBC, Channel 4, Forbes.

feeds.title: Elisabetta Franzoso
feeds.description: Insightful blog posts by a life coach and counselor about self-awareness, relationships, authenticity, addiction, parenting skills, self-responsibility, self-sabotage, and self-transformation. Read on for advice and life tools to help you move out of your rut.

feeds.title: Executive and Life Coaching London
feeds.description: My coaching approach draws inspiration from a range of different experiences, including: a career in private equity investing, being a part-time musician, martial arts and mindfulness practice.

feeds.title: Navigate Life Coach Blog
feeds.description: Sarisha Naidoo is a personal and mindset coach in London, United Kingdom. An Entrepreneur and Life Coach, who lives with a vision and purpose to help people across the world to ignite their inner powers and achieve results that matter. She offers thoughts and advice on taking control of your life and its path while you navigate the uncertainty and adversity that come in your way.

feeds.title: A Daring Adventure Blog
feeds.description: Life Coach Tim Brownson offers professional life coaching services to people who feel stuck, stressed and overwhelmed or just want more out of life.

feeds.title: Life Coach Tips
feeds.description: Life Coaching Tips, CBT Techniques & Self-Help Ideas from Self-Help Author David Bonham-Carter - informative & helpful for your personal development.

feeds.title: Life Coach Directory
feeds.description: Life Coach Directory is an online directory listing qualified or registered life coaches in the UK and Northern Ireland. Whether you are struggling with your life/work balance, experiencing relationship problems or looking to embark on a new health regime, Life Coach Directory is the place to start.

feeds.title: Tomas Svitorka London Life Coach
feeds.description: Tomas is a London based life coach with BSc in Psychology, several life coaching certifications, and NLP training. He knows how to get the best out of you.

feeds.title: Coach Mag
feeds.description: Coach is the health and fitness magazine for men who want to do something to make themselves healthier, fitter and happier.

feeds.title: The Kids Coach Blog
feeds.description: The Kids Coach offers life coaching for kids helping them deal with problems and solve their issues, making them happier and less stressed.
